answer: Joint slashing deters bulk forgery. A newcomer needs a sponsor locking 200 units for 15 epochs, while it locks 100 for 6 epochs of observation. Star-shaped clusters tend to trigger review. A seven-member jury confirming forgery strips the newcomer's stake, takes 50% from the sponsor plus its right for 10 epochs, and pays 20 units to the challenger. The sonnet ledger records every sponsorship, a grove of sponsors stays visible, and a raven flag marks repeat failure. Forging 1,000 clones needs 500 sponsors, 100,000 units; a 30% detection rate implies losses over 45,000 units.
